correctness.rationale: Under indegree/outdegree at most one every component is a finite path/cycle; Dung stability forces one alternating path selection and exactly two complementary even-cycle phases. Three phase bits on a cycle either coincide or have exactly one agreeing pair; replacing a constant column by a nonconstant one weakly increases all pairwise distances. Classifying cycles by agreeing pair gives distances W-w1, W-w2, W-w3 and the exact identity, with every partition realized. For r at least two positive weights the optimum has maxload less than W, hence gives distinct extensions. The DP recurrence is exhaustive. The standalone finite checker directly enumerated 35 examples, but no finite enumeration was used as the infinite-size proof.

value.rationale: The natural three-viewpoint worst-pair extension-diversity invariant is not determined by the known pairwise diameter; it depends on the distribution of actual even-cycle lengths. The theorem gives a complete exact structural evaluation and polynomial algorithm on a natural nonbranching argumentation class with potentially exponentially many stable extensions. Its balance criterion and equal-cycle formula identify genuine parameter effects and possible extremizers; no downstream general theorem is claimed.
